purpose: Missed-spur regression review; do not add this regression photograph to training and claim an independent test result on it.
review_instructions: Confirm whether the curved pale protrusion behind the visible lower leg is a spur.
Trace only the visible spur outline and its tight bounding box; label occlusion or an ambiguous base/tip explicitly.
Review leg boxes and head/feather false positives. Leave uncertain anatomy unlabeled for review, not a fabricated positive or a confirmed negative.

Review existing annotation candidates for small visible spurs in full-body photographs and explicitly reviewed negative regions/images. Reuse existing photographs; no new dataset collection is required.
Keep duplicate/source-family groups together across training, validation and testing.

api_proposals.source: Executed API request; prediction only, not a verified annotation
